infobox.title: प्राइवेसी स्टैक
infobox.imageCaption: GL.iNet router के साथ AdGuard Home running नेटवर्क-व्यापी DNS फ़िल्टरिंग

lead:
मेरे **प्राइवेसी स्टैक** is एक परतदार व्यक्तिगत गोपनीयता और सुरक्षा सेटअप spanning OS hardening, ब्राउज़र fingerprint resistance, hardware-level नेटवर्क filtering, self-hosted services, और planned email migration. It currently sits at approximately **85% पूर्णता** — the main remaining gap is Gmail, which I haven't yet migrated to a गोपनीयता-respecting provider.

I've built the entire stack on free और open source software, which connects philosophically to [[foss-coin|FOSS Coin]] और the broader FOSS-first approach documented in मेरे [[about|profile]]. Every layer is either already deployed or has a concrete plan के लिए deployment through मेरे [[homelab|Libre Cloud homelab]].

content.content:
The OS layer is the foundation. Running **Arch Linux via [[linux-setup|Omarchy]]** gives me the most control over what software is installed और what runs in the background. Hyprland Wayland tiling WM has minimal background services by design — compared to a typical desktop environment, the attack surface और telemetry footprint are dramatically reduced.

Key decisions I made at this layer:
- **Chromium removed** (telemetry) — replaced के साथ LibreWolf
- **Spotify removed** (tracking) — no replacement
- **MAC address randomisation** enabled on all नेटवर्क interfaces
- **Fork control**: I maintain a personal गिटहब fork of Omarchy to selectively apply upstream changes on मेरे own terms

content.title: मेरा विश्वास मॉडल
content.content: Arch packages flow through the Arch pacman ecoसिस्टम, not DHH's servers. Even using Omarchy, the underlying package signatures और build infrastructure remain the Arch Linux परियोजना's — not a third party's.

मैं उपयोग करता हूँ **LibreWolf** — a Firefox fork के साथ hardened anti-fingerprinting defaults applied out of the box. Key differences from stock Firefox that I care about:
- `resistFingerprinting` enabled by default — canvas, WebGL, audio, timezone, और font fingerprinting are all blocked
- No telemetry or crash reporting sent to Mozilla
- Stricter cookie defaults और cross-site isolation

**uBlock Origin** runs on top of LibreWolf in medium mode — blocking all third-party scripts और frames by default, के साथ manual allowlist rules I've added over time के लिए sites that require scripts to function.

I also explored Firefox Multi-Account Containers के लिए session isolation per site category (banking in one container, social media in another, shopping in another).

content.title: ज्ञात विशेषता — डार्क थीम
content.content: LibreWolf's resistFingerprinting setting can break dark mode rendering on some sites. Fix: toggle resistFingerprinting off और on in about:config to restore correct theming. I've hit this a few times.
The DNS layer is the most technically layered part of मेरे stack — मैं चलाता हूँ multiple filtering सिस्टमs at different levels:

rows.दायरा: AdGuard Home on home subnet — blocks ads/malware के लिए all devices on मेरे home नेटवर्क
Custom profile के साथ telemetry blocking
Ads + Trackers + Malware filtering on मेरे laptop और phone
योजित — will encrypt traffic from device to homelab exit node

content.title: कॉलेज WiFi बाधा
content.content: SonicWALL SSL inspection on the college WiFi blocks pacman package downloads. मेरे workaround: mobile hotspot के लिए सिस्टम updates on campus.

rows.स्थिति: ❌ लंबित — मेरा मुख्य अंतर. Custom domain contact@lingadevaru.in active.
✅ Live — no fingerprinting, no Google Analytics on any site I own
